test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 10 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The actual growth rate of the ninth and tenth five years plans was ______ and _____ respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**5.4 percent, and 7.6 percent.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ninth five-year plan (1997-2002):**

 
 
• It achieved a **GDP growth rate of 5.4%, **lower than the target.
 
• Yet, industrial growth was **4.5%** which was higher than the targeted** 3%**.
 
• The service industry had a growth rate of** 7.8%**.
 
• An average annual growth rate of** 6.7%** was reached.
 
• Quality of life, generation of productive employment, regional balance, and self-reliance.Growth with social justice and equality. growth target** 6.5%.**
 
 
 
• **Tenth five-year plan (2002-2007):**
 
 
• It was successful in reducing the poverty ratio by **5%,** increasing forest cover to 25%, increasing literacy rates to 75 %, and the **economic growth of the country by over 8%.**
 
• To achieve an 8% GDP growth rate, Reduce poverty by 5 points, and increase the literacy rate in the country.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **About Five Year Plan:**

 
 
• The Five Year Plan in India was **first launched in 1951.**
 
• Since also, India has witnessed 12 different Five Time Plans with different objects and results.
 
• In 2015, the current Narendra Modi Led government put the Five Time Plan in India to rest.
 
• The Five Year Plan in India has been replaced by a 15- time vision plan supported by 3- time action plans.
 
• According to the government, India needs a long-term vision for its growth and development in colorful sectors and fields.
